stress.label: Stress Load

explanations.Low: Your Stress Index is within the favourable range used for the Restore assessment. Stress Load reflects how much stress the body is carrying internally, which can be influenced by physical, mental and emotional demands.
explanations.Mild: Your body appears to be carrying a mild level of stress at the time of assessment. Stress Load reflects how much stress the body is carrying internally, which can be influenced by physical, mental and emotional demands.
explanations.Elevated: Your body appears to be carrying a higher level of stress at the time of assessment. Stress Load reflects how much stress the body is carrying internally, which can be influenced by physical, mental and emotional demands.
explanations.High: Your body appears to be carrying a high level of stress at the time of assessment. Stress Load reflects how much stress the body is carrying internally, which can be influenced by physical, mental and emotional demands.

stress.measured: Based on your **Stress Index**, which looks at changes in the timing of your heartbeat (**heart-rate variability**) to show how much stress your body may be carrying.

recovery.label: Recovery Capacity

explanations.Favourable: Your pulse pattern falls within the favourable range used for the Restore assessment. Recovery Capacity reflects how well your body appears able to adapt and recover from physical or emotional demands.
explanations.Reduced: Your pulse pattern suggests your body may currently have less capacity to adapt and recover from physical or emotional demands than the favourable range.
explanations.Needs Support: Your pulse pattern suggests your body would benefit from support to adapt and recover from physical or emotional demands.

recovery.measured: Based on **Pulse Complexity**, which looks at how varied and adaptable your pulse pattern is.

circulation.label: Circulation
circulation.readingLabel: Vascular Age Type | Vascular Age Index

explanations.Favourable: Your blood flow and artery-related readings are within the favourable range.
explanations.Favourable - Monitor Index: Your artery-condition pattern is favourable. Your current Vascular Age Index is slightly above the ideal range, so it is worth monitoring at your next review.
explanations.Favourable Pattern - Index Needs Review: Your artery-condition pattern is favourable, but your current Vascular Age Index reading is well above the ideal range and should be reviewed with your consultant.
explanations.Monitor: Your artery-condition pattern suggests circulation would benefit from attention. Circulation reflects how well blood and fluids appear to be moving around the body.
explanations.Needs Attention: Your circulation readings suggest this area would benefit from support. Circulation reflects how well blood and fluids appear to be moving around the body.

circulation.measured: Based on **Vascular Age Type** and **Vascular Age Index**, which look at your pulse-wave pattern to give an indication of your circulation and artery condition.
